hero.title: Hi, I'm Sakin!
hero.des0: I'm a Software Engineer building high-performance, full-stack applications. Currently pursuing MSc in AI at BTU Cottbus-Senftenberg.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Selected projects I've built — from AI-powered tools to full-stack platforms serving thousands of users.

tryOnAI.subtitle: Virtual Try-On Chatbot
tryOnAI.description: An AI-powered virtual clothing try-on chatbot that can be seamlessly integrated into any website, enabling users to visualize how clothes look on them before purchasing.

tryOn.subtitle: TryOn Chrome Extension
tryOn.description: A Chrome extension that lets you virtually try on clothes on Amazon, Facebook, Instagram, and other platforms using AI-powered image generation.

snipClip.subtitle: Audio/Video Clip Extractor
snipClip.description: Extract precise audio or video clips from long recordings with multiple speakers by simply providing a reference audio sample — powered by speaker diarization.

ytchat.subtitle: Chat with YouTube Videos
ytchat.description: A RAG-powered platform that lets you have natural conversations with YouTube video content using Generative AI, semantic search, and vector embeddings.

cms.subtitle: Complaint Management System
cms.description: A full-stack complaint management platform with automated text classification using logistic regression, real-time tracking, and an admin portal for community-driven issue resolution.
